title: Development of a Robust Read-Across Model for the Prediction of Biological Potency of Novel Peroxisome Proliferator-Activated Receptor Delta Agonists.
authors: Antoniou, Maria; Papavasileiou, Konstantinos D; Melagraki, Georgia; Dondero, Francesco; Lynch, Iseult; Afantitis, Antreas
one_liner_zh: 该文开发PPARδ激动剂生物活性的QSAR预测模型，虽涉及核受体转录因子但聚焦小分子配体活性预测，未研究蛋白-DNA互作或结合机制，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: A robust predictive model was developed using 136 novel peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor delta (PPARdelta) agonists, a distinct subtype of lipid-activated transcription factors of the nuclear receptor superfamily that regulate target genes by binding to characteristic sequences of DNA bases. The model employs various structural descriptors and docking calculations and provides predictions of the biological activity of PPARdelta agonists, following the criteria of the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) for the development and validation of quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) models. Specifically focused on small molecules, the model facilitates the identification of highly potent and selective PPARdelta agonists and offers a read-across concept by providing the chemical neighbours of the compound under study. The model development process was conducted on Isalos Analytics Software (v. 0.1.17) which provides an intuitive environment for machine-learning applications. The final model was released as a user-friendly web tool and can be accessed through the Enalos Cloud platform's graphical user interface (GUI).
abstract_zh: 利用136种新型过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体δ（PPARdelta）激动剂，开发了一个稳健的预测模型，这些激动剂是核受体超家族中脂质激活转录因子的一个独特亚型，通过结合特征性的DNA碱基序列来调控靶基因。该模型采用多种结构描述符和对接计算，并根据经济合作与发展组织（OECD）关于定量构效关系（QSAR）模型开发与验证的标准，提供PPARdelta激动剂生物活性的预测。该模型特别聚焦于小分子，有助于识别高效且选择性的PPARdelta激动剂，并通过提供所研究化合物的化学邻近体，实现交叉参照（read-across）概念。模型开发过程在Isalos Analytics Software（v. 0.1.17）上进行，该软件为机器学习应用提供了直观的环境。最终模型以用户友好的网络工具形式发布，可通过Enalos云平台的图形用户界面（GUI）访问。
